notes: All selectors use per-attempt DokuSelectionRuntime/State; 1.22 NL algorithm branches retained.
Candidate start/queue consumption/frozen policy/current round snapshot use one RoundService commit.
All 1.22 board/input features merged onto DokuBoardState; paid mouse/draft and life variants use domain transactions.
Pure mouse selector moved from presentation/main to domain; full-map updated.
Built-in binary banks retained; content JSON overrides validate new banks and pace, materialize packed fields.
Live field reads are tracked per executed candidate method; delta merge is recursive and conflict checked.
Only direct NL selector globals remain at LevelSelector boundary; all 6 runtime optional-argument omissions were fixed.
New fixed-catalog priority, remote explicit policy overlays and pace/main generation coupling are retained.
Incoming LevelSelector _get_resolver/_finalize/_fail_and_restore are intentionally replaced by independent runtime + atomic delivery.
All 112 enabled normal_level variants execute in matrix; fixed nested cursor/strategy runtime forwarding and V6 inherited provider runtime.
Pure DokuRoundPerformance owns score, combo, steps, tool use, draft duration/exit stats. ProductPort persists deltas and checkpoint in same action transaction; animations only consume events.
Paid draft activation repeats per entry, lethal draft commits only actual wrong cells, revive mirrors both revive_count and rv_count with rank pending reset.
BoardView.apply_committed_board preserves tracking/input locks. Prewarming retains each Cell private presentation model until valid setup; negative pointer geometry uses floor.
Public builtin content API materializes packed 1.22 rows into JSON-compatible values, retaining compressed hot path. Provider and sorter caches invalidate per ContentContext generation.
Legacy bounded-selection diagnostics compatibility isolated in LegacySelectionAdapter; 1.22 production resolver remains unchanged.
Input lifecycle uses 1.22 touch slots, single/multi modes and solution step log, with focus/visibility/global/brief masks and lost-release ownership cleanup.
New entry reloads committed Tracker identity and solution steps; restart clears only round steps, retaining total steps.
1.8 undo/axis/automatic-complete buttons retired by 1.22; tests now use Mouse, paid Draft, multi-touch and auto-x bonus. Domain old action compatibility remains supported.
Frozen local multi_touch/swipe_logic/doubletap_protect interpreters never call set_debug_override or mutate global experiment state; changed-live-AB real input regression passes.
New actual-board materialization covers fixed catalog, JSON SP rank integer normalization, bank UI and previous/next routing; all 254 bank dimension checks pass.
Base/Main/Daily entry preparation captures UI presentation ownership before super calls; synchronous BGM settings commits cannot continue an old preparation on a replacement page.
Terminal bonus fault found existing toast cache loss during GameState failed reload; business state now preserves only the 5 accepted display caches and keeps other candidate state atomic.
Gameplay modules documentation rewritten for 1.22 and selector stager injection; no retired undo button described as current UI.
Input Blocker and Mouse completion teardown found by destructive real-page regression; completion cancellation must synchronously release any parent terminal awaits before page free.
Debug auto-complete reuses pure ActionRules plan; a page-bound sorting closure held across await caused inherited script resource leakage and has been removed.

Complete operation lifecycle 115 assertions passes strict --verbose, including Mouse last-cat terminal destruction; complete terminal publication 144 assertions passes strict with current scene resources.
Static audit found only fastjump and simulator as non-page selection consumers; both now commit selection plus progress atomically and stop on write failures.

Simulator cached retry preserves delivered puzzle identity/frozen policy and clears failed retry after successful candidate settlement; default uses 1.22 normal_level while explicit size_cycle remains available for comparison. Simulator intentionally does not fabricate Elo score facts.

Selection effects are now published after successful commits by the injected product callback for RoundSession, legacy diagnostic bridge, and LevelData.commit_selected; duplicate plans and reset/replacement generations suppress publication.

Assist tag refresh uses the actual usertag_ready signal and storage-epoch/request-sequence guards; cold first selection honors persisted confirmation without mutating state. Real deferred SDK subclass regression covers stale completion and pending readiness reset.

Unified SpecialProvider.levels_for(runtime) replaces all 37 strategy constant accesses, LevelData membership, HardRatingSelector schedule iteration and Main returnee membership; absent override uses built-in schedule while explicit empty override removes it.

Four optional runtime omissions in NL12002 returnee size and NL12100/NL12207/NL12208 fusion settlement now preserve frozen content configuration; matrix covers these branches and all 112 enabled groups.

Final selection-effects 49, matrix 588, selection transaction 12 assertions pass strict verbose; matrix tests added/deleted special schedules against real returnee, six recommendation preview, and hard-rank paths.

Returnee fixtures must pair size/rank with an available exactly-one-single-region pool; read-only diagnostic found 5x5/rank2 valid while 7x7/rank1 and 8x8/rank2 empty. No original algorithm or empty-pool assertion was relaxed.

Final all-suite diagnostics found active board_enter_1.ogg playback leaked Ogg resources on engine shutdown. SoundManager._exit_tree explicitly stops players and clears streams without events/storage callbacks; root applied the 11-line fix. Private catalog91/audio13/operation115 all pass strict verbose.

confirm_canonical_revision.cause: ConfirmDialog overrode the framework presentation getter with its local animation counter. Normal on_hide incremented that counter, causing the new manager post-hide ownership guard to return before stack removal and hidden publication. The HIDDEN dialog stayed in_stack and destroy_ui waited indefinitely.
